description: Overview Dual Y-Axis Combo Chart (Pro) for Power BI enables analysts and business users to compare multiple KPIs—revenue, profit, volume, and targets—within a single advanced dual-axis combo chart. By combining column, line, area, and scatter charts, teams can quickly identify trends, variances, and performance gaps across business scenarios. This certified Power BI visual supports flexible chart combinations and built-in analytics for real-world reporting across finance, sales, operations, and executive dashboards.
